verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance documents a Scribe Agent that joins incident calls, transcribes meetings in real time, and records key decisions and action items. It also documents generative AI that summarizes key information about an incident. That covers the scribed call notes and live summaries, but nothing shows AI drafting stakeholder or status updates. Missing for 10: documented AI-drafted incident/status updates, in-depth docs on live summary behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing

citations.quote: Transcribe incident meetings in real time to enhance incident summaries and post-incident reviews
Schedule a Scribe Agent to join incident calls and record key decisions, action items, and events once a conference bridge is available.
generative AI for summarizing key information about an incident
